application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.source: scripts/checks/source_audit/tsukuba_tumftm_ppl/check_ppl_audit.py (RARD logs in cell_level/20180701-0731.zip, 15 Jul 2018, and 20250101_0131.zip, 15 Jan 2025, read through fielddata.loaders.ppl.cell_level_preview)
cell_channels_measured.note: Individual voltages for all 4,760 cells (238 per rack row, 20 racks), each logged every 100 s, are in the RARD logs of the publisher's cell-level share linked from the repository's Cell_Level_Data file; the annual ESS CSVs hold only system-level averages and extremes. Two days checked.

obs_hours.note: Observation-hours are not used when calendar spans are measurable or no cadence is available.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://github.com/PPLResearch/BESS-Analysis; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
sentinels_documented.note: Zeros in SOH, cell voltages, AvgSOC and module temperatures during outages are observed placeholders, not documented by the publisher; clean=True masks them (source audit 2026-10-04).
